description: This Java class defines a ProductService component in a Spring Boot application responsible for managing product-related operations such as retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of products via a repository. It uses transaction management, dependency injection, and DTO mapping.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: Service class for managing products in the application, providing CRUD operations and product queries with pagination.

methods.name: getAvailableProducts
methods.description: Lists products that are marked as available, with pagination.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Fetches products belonging to a specified category, supporting pagination.

methods.name: searchProducts
methods.description: Searches for products by name, ignoring case, with pagination.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a single product by its unique ID.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product entry in the repository from a DTO.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with new details from a DTO.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Removes a product identified by ID from the repository.
